children: RNS Number : 1113E  Hellenic Telecomms Organization S A  20 November 2026

Hellenic Telecommunications Organization S.A. (“OTE”) announces that in the context of ‘’OTE Shares Award’’ Program for 2026, as approved by the competent corporate bodies, Mr Charalampos Mazarakis, Chief Financial Officer OTE Group, according to his transaction notification to the Company dated 20.11.2026, purchased on 19.11.2026 2,650 shares of OTE (LEI ELPUFM0XZRZO4LFXW404) on the Euronext Athens market, at an average price of €18.6395 for a total value of € 49,394.74.

The announcement is issued as a Regulated Information, in accordance with Law 3556/2007, [article 3, par. 1 (p) and article 21] and Regulation No 596/2014 (article 19) of the European Parliament and of the Council on market abuse.
